title: Identify approval targets in audit events
goal: Make approvalRequested and approvalResolved event records identify the exact typed Skill or Tool being approved, linked by actionID.
context: ActionIntent now carries typed skillID and toolID, but approval audit events currently omit target identity. The event stream records that approval happened without revealing which Skill/Tool the user was asked to approve.
forbidden_changes: Do not infer target identity from summary text.
Do not change approval outcomes or policy semantics.
Do not put both toolID and skillID on a single action unless the proposal actually carries both.
acceptance_criteria: approvalRequested includes typed skillID or toolID when present.
approvalResolved preserves the same target identity and actionID.
Skill approval events carry skillID and omit toolID.
Approval behavior remains unchanged and all three required CI gates pass on final head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: Build event payload from the already typed ActionIntent and assert request/resolution identity consistency in the approval integration test.
